usage: preflight.py [-h] [--repo-root REPO_ROOT] --experiment-id EXPERIMENT_ID
                    --expected-branch EXPECTED_BRANCH --expected-head
                    EXPECTED_HEAD --runner RUNNER --run-dir RUN_DIR
                    [--domain DOMAIN] [--transport {dds,inprocess}]
                    [--held-lock-fd HELD_LOCK_FD]
                    [--qualification QUALIFICATION]
                    [--participants PARTICIPANTS]
                    [--dds-policy {linux-safe,spec-only}]
                    [--baseline-runner BASELINE_RUNNER]
                    [--diff-base DIFF_BASE]
                    [--changed-surface {analyzer,runner,runtime,scene,schema}]
                    [--requires-sol-review] [--approved-head APPROVED_HEAD]
                    [--require-file REQUIRE_FILE] [--hash HASH_REQUIREMENTS]
                    [--test TEST] [--process-name PROCESS_NAME]
                    [--output OUTPUT]

Fail-closed preflight for expensive Go2 research runs. Checks execution
integrity, not scientific merit. Scientific intent remains a human/agent
review responsibility under docs/research/SOP.md.

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --repo-root REPO_ROOT
  --experiment-id EXPERIMENT_ID
  --expected-branch EXPECTED_BRANCH
  --expected-head EXPECTED_HEAD
                        exact HEAD prepared and reviewed for this checkpoint
  --runner RUNNER
  --run-dir RUN_DIR
  --domain DOMAIN
  --transport {dds,inprocess}
  --held-lock-fd HELD_LOCK_FD
  --qualification QUALIFICATION
                        verified content-bound offline test receipt
  --participants PARTICIPANTS
                        reserved participant count (controller and simulator
                        default)
  --dds-policy {linux-safe,spec-only}
  --baseline-runner BASELINE_RUNNER
  --diff-base DIFF_BASE
                        accepted parent/baseline ref used to auto-detect
                        changed execution surfaces
  --changed-surface {analyzer,runner,runtime,scene,schema}
                        manual override/addition
  --requires-sol-review
                        use when a runner/analyzer/tooling diff changes
                        trajectory or primary evidence meaning
  --approved-head APPROVED_HEAD
  --require-file REQUIRE_FILE
  --hash HASH_REQUIREMENTS
  --test TEST           reviewed no-live/build test command
  --process-name PROCESS_NAME
  --output OUTPUT       JSON report; stdout or ignored/out-of-repo path
                        recommended
